courses.title: Spreadsheet Basics: Getting Started
courses.description: Spreadsheet Basics: Getting Started is a short, practical course covering navigating a spreadsheet, entering data, and saving your work. You'll follow along with example spreadsheets and practise on your own data, with no prior spreadsheet experience assumed. Expect brief lessons and small hands-on exercises rather than a long project, so you can fit it into a short break and still come away with something you can use right away.
learning_outcomes: Finding your way around the spreadsheet interface
Avoiding a few common beginner mistakes
